note: This error occurs when a legacy template ID is referenced. The system falls back to the default template automatically.
resolution: No action needed. The fallback mechanism handles this gracefully.

note: Transient timeout to the upstream rendering service. Usually self-resolves within 2-3 minutes.
resolution: Monitor for 5 minutes. If it persists beyond 10 minutes, check the rendering service health.

note: Known issue with the font CDN during deployments. The system uses a fallback font.
resolution: No immediate action. This is tracked in JIRA-4521.

note: The document generation API hit the rate limiter. Requests are queued and retried.
resolution: Check current traffic levels. If sustained, coordinate with the platform team to increase limits.

note: Cache invalidation lag after a recent deployment. Resolves automatically within 5-10 minutes.
resolution: No action needed. The cache TTL will expire naturally.
